# Breach to Claim

> Open class-action data-breach and privacy settlements in the US, each read off its official court-authorized settlement website: claim deadline, what it pays, who is in the class, and where to file. Independent; not legal advice. Updated 2026-11-19T22:13:01.851Z.

- 82 settlements open for claims; 31 close within 30 days, 10 within 7.
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://breach-to-claim.vercel.app/mcp — tools find_breach_settlement, list_open_breach_settlements, breach_settlement_details.
- Full list as JSON: https://breach-to-claim.vercel.app/settlements.json
- Each settlement page: https://breach-to-claim.vercel.app/s/<slug>/

## Carter Credit Union (data breach)

- Claim deadline: 2026-11-19 (0 days left on 2026-11-19)
- Pays: Three years of CyEx Financial Shield Complete credit monitoring with $1 million fraud insurance. | Reimbursement of documented out-of-pocket losses traceable to the Data Incident, up to $2,500. | One-time $50 cash payment instead of loss reimbursement; no proof needed.
- Most cash: $2,500; option without receipts: yes
- Needs the code on the notice: not stated
- Who is in the class: “All persons whose PII was compromised because of the Data Incident experienced by Defendant beginning on or about June 25, 2025.”
- Case: Ellis, et al. v. Carter Credit Union d/b/a Carter Federal Credit Union, 662980-C, 1st Judicial District Court, Parish of Caddo, for the State of Louisiana
- Administrator: Simpluris
- Official site: https://ccudatasettlement.com/ ; claim form: https://ccudatasettlement.com/form/claim
- Read from: https://ccudatasettlement.com/, https://ccudatasettlement.com/faq/, https://ccudatasettlement.com/dates/ on 2026-11-19
- Page: https://breach-to-claim.vercel.app/s/carter-credit-union/

## La Jolla Group (data breach)

- Claim deadline: 2026-11-23 (4 days left on 2026-11-19)
- Pays: Two years of one-bureau credit monitoring with identity theft insurance; no documentation needed. | Up to 4 hours at $25/hour for time spent dealing with the incident; attestation only. | Reimbursement of documented unreimbursed out-of-pocket losses from the incident, up to $2,000. | $95 for California Subclass, $45 for others, instead of loss claims; no documentation.

- Needs the code on the notice: yes
- Who is in the class: All current and former employees of La Jolla Group who reside in the United States and whose information was impacted by the Cybersecurity Incident.

- Claim deadline: 2026-11-25 (6 days left on 2026-11-19)
- Pays: Equal pro rata share of the net settlement fund for each valid claim; no documentation required. | JJCI deletes Skin360 images and maintains notice, consent, and retention policies.
- Most cash: not stated; option without receipts: yes
- Needs the code on the notice: not stated
- Who is in the class: A Settlement Class Member is any person who, while in Illinois, performed a Skin360® skin assessment using any version of Skin360®, including Neutrogena® Skin360®, NeoStrata® Skin360®, and any Skin360® collaborations with other entities (collectively, “Skin360®”), whether via mobile application or web application, between December 9, 2019 and May 5, 2023.
- Case: Melzer v. Johnson & Johnson Consumer Inc., 3:22−CV−03149-MAS-RLS, United States District Court for the District of New Jersey
- Administrator: Eisner Advisory Group LLC

- Most cash: $20; option without receipts: yes
- Needs the code on the notice: not stated
- Who is in the class: Settlement Class is defined to mean all patients of Prime Healthcare and the Relevant Hospitals that accessed and/or utilized any of the Prime Web Properties during the period from November 1, 2019, through the date all tracking pixels were definitively removed from the respective Prime Web Property for each such Relevant Hospital, as reflected in Appendix A.
- Case: Doe, et al. v. Prime Healthcare Services, Inc., et al., 23STCV26800, Superior Court of California, Los Angeles County
- Administrator: Kroll
- Official site: https://phsettlement.com/ ; claim form: https://forms.ksacms.com/efiling/fr/tform/doe_v_primehealthcareservices_claimform/new?form-version=1
